ValidationRule.description: Prevents the system changing status back to "ID Ops: Daon OK" once it's already updated to "Equifax Fallout" or "ID Check OK" or "Fraud Check: Daon OK"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c ), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Fraud_Check", RecordType.DeveloperName = "ID_Ops_Assistance" ), OR( ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status ), "ID Check OK"), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status ), "Equifax Fallout") ), OR( ISPICKVAL( Status, "ID Ops: Daon OK"), ISPICKVAL( Status, "Fraud Check: Daon OK") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invalid Status change from (Equifax Fallout or ID Check OK) to (ID Ops: Daon OK or Fraud Check: Daon OK)
